_note: Exported props of a checked JavaScript component, typed with JSDoc in three places. A `@type` between `export` and `let` types nothing for `ts.getJSDocType`, so upstream adds no widening assertion and TypeScript narrows the prop to its initializer (TS2367 on the comparison); the comment stays in the overlay because only the `export` keyword is removed.
